spec.name: Polar Ridge Research Outpost
spec.description: A Firewatch-style flat-colour diorama of a small arctic research station: a burnt-orange stilted cabin with a snowy roof and chimney, a connected lab module with a radome, a guyed radio mast, a wind turbine and a yard of fuel tanks, a snowmobile and a sled, all on a faceted snow drift base with ice crags.
spec.layout: Static diorama on one faceted snow platform, about 8.8 m square, centred on x=0 and standing on y=0. The snow is a low irregular octagonal slab whose flat top sits at y=0.35. The platform reads from the front (+Z), and everything else sits on y=0.35 (feet may sink 0.05). From front to back: a yard strip (z 1.6 to 4.2) with stepping-stone path, snowmobile and sled; the MAIN CABIN centre-left (x -2.9..1.3, z -1.9..1.9, floor y=0.8 on timber piles) with a covered porch and steps facing +Z; a LAB MODULE centre-right (x 2.0..4.0, z -1.8..1.2) joined to the cabin by a short enclosed corridor at x 1.3..2.0; a fuel-tank cluster on the left flank (x -4.3..-3.0, z -1.0..3.2); at the back, the RADIO MAST (back-left, x -3.4, z -3.0, top y 6.6) and the WIND TURBINE (back-right, x 3.0, z -3.1, hub y 5.0, blade radius 1.3). Jagged ice and rock crags fill the back centre (x -2.2..1.2, z -4.4..-3.4, up to y 2.2). Style: Firewatch flat colour. Bold simple blocky silhouettes, sunset palette with warm burnt orange, ochre and cream on lit faces and dusky purple-pink on shadow sides. Each snow mass uses a warm pale snowLit top and a snowShade or snowDeep sliver on its sides or underside. Every window glows warm yellow with a dark frame. Roofs carry a thick snow cap built as separate slabs. Trim is cream. No gradients; every detail is a small part in its own flat colour, seated on the surface. Faceted, low-segment shapes (6 to 8 sides) only.

parts.builds: The platform and everything natural. A faceted octagonal snow slab (radius about 4.3) from y=0 to a flat top at y=0.35: lower rim band in snowDeep, middle band in snowShade, top slabs in snowLit, so the dark underside shows around the edge. Overlapping low drift wedges and humps (snowLit tops, snowShade sides) piled against the building feet, along the back and at the corners, never above y 0.7 near buildings. Back-centre crags at x -2.2..1.2, z -4.4..-3.4: five to seven tall faceted prisms and cones in rock and rockLight, up to y 2.2, with snow caps (snowLit) on top and chunks of iceBlue and iceDeep ice shards leaning among them. Smaller scattered rocks with snow caps at two or three other edge spots, kept out of the building and yard footprints. A packed-snow path of flat stepping stones (snowShade, slightly above the snow top) leading from stairFoot at the porch to the front edge and a second branch toward labDoor. A few small orange survey-flag poles (wood pole, safetyOrange triangle flag) along the path. Slim footprints and sled-track grooves as small dark-snowDeep flat strips are optional. The terrain does not build any building, tank, vehicle, mast or turbine.
parts.attaches: Its top at terrainTop y=0.35 is the floor for every other part; they sink into it by up to 0.05. Path begins at stairFoot and the labDoor step.

parts.builds: The main habitat cabin, the hero building. Eight to ten timber piles (wood, woodDark caps) from y 0.3 to the floor at y 0.8, with a woodDark floor slab. Walls x -2.9..1.3, z -1.9..1.9, from y 0.8 to the eave at y 2.9, in cabinWall with horizontal clapboard lines as thin cabinWallShade strips and cream corner posts and a cream base trim board. Gable roof with its ridge along x at y 3.9 and overhang 0.3: two roofDark slopes plus a thick snowLit snow cap slab on each, a snowShade underside lip, cream fascia boards, and triangular gable ends (cabinWall) with a small glowing round attic window (windowGlow with a frameDark ring) on each end. Front face (+Z): door at x -0.8 (wood, cream frame, small glowing window, brass-like tarpOchre handle), two windows either side at x -2.0 and x 0.4, each with a frameDark frame, windowGlow panes, a cross muntin, a cream sill and snowLit sill snow. The left wall (x -2.9) has two windows. The back wall has one window and a stacked woodDark firewood pile with snow cap beside it. A brick-like chimney (rockLight and rock bricks, snowLit cap) on the roof at x -1.9, z -0.7, top at y 4.4 with three or four stacked smoke puffs of snowShade and snowLit above it (chunky low-poly blobs, a drifting column). A covered porch: deck at y 0.8 from z 1.9 to 2.9, x -1.7..0.1 (wood planks as separate strips), two corner posts, a small shed roof (roofDark with snow cap), a railing with balusters, wide steps (3 treads) down to stairFoot at z 3.5. A hanging lantern by the door (frameDark cage, windowGlow core), a safetyOrange life-ring or a weather sign board beside the door with a simple emblem, an antenna whip and a roof-vent cap on the roof, a cream stripe of icicles (iceBlue small cones) along the front eave. On the cabin's right wall (x 1.3) a doorway at z -0.3 where the corridor joins (just trim the cream frame, no door leaf).
parts.attaches: Stands on terrainTop via piles. Right wall at x 1.3 meets the labModule corridor at corridorJoin. Porch steps end at stairFoot. The chimney top is at chimneyTop. The cabin's roof overhang reaches x 1.6 but stays above y 2.9, so it clears the corridor (top y 2.3).

parts.builds: The science lab annex. A short enclosed corridor from corridorJoin (cabin right wall, x 1.3) to x 2.0, about 1.1 wide (z -0.85..0.25) and y 0.8..2.3: labWhite walls, labTeal roof strip with a snow cap, a small glowing window, a cream door frame at the cabin end. The lab body: x 2.0..4.0, z -1.8..1.2, floor y 0.8 on 6 piles (metalGrey, woodDark caps), walls to y 2.9 in labWhite with horizontal labTeal band stripes at y 1.4 and y 2.6 and safetyOrange corner posts. A low-pitched shed-style roof (labTeal, thick snowLit snow cap, snowShade lip). Front face (+Z at z 1.2): a door at x 3.0 (metalGrey with a safetyOrange stripe, round porthole of windowGlow with frameDark ring), a small landing and two steps down to y 0.35 (z 1.2..1.6), a painted emblem sign above the door made of small parts (a signalRed disc with labWhite snowflake or atom arms). Two wide windows with frameDark frames and windowGlow panes with a tall glowing slit. Side wall x 4.0: a vent grille (stacked metalDark slats) and a round exhaust duct with a cap. Back wall: a cable inlet box (metalDark) at labBackWall. On the roof: a radome, a half-sphere in labWhite (radius 0.7, centre at x 3.0, z -0.8, y 2.9) on a metalDark ring base, with panel seam lines as thin rings in labTeal and a signalRed beacon on top; a Stevenson-style weather screen (white louvered box on four legs) at x 2.5, z 0.5 on the roof; an anemometer (three small cups on a spinner arm, thin mast) on the roof corner. Snow banks piled against the base are in the terrain part, so only build a small snow cap on each step here.
parts.attaches: Corridor meets the mainCabin at corridorJoin. Lab floor mount labFloor, door at labDoor, back wall inlet at labBackWall (the commsPower power cable ends there). Piles stand on terrainTop.

parts.builds: Two tall landmarks at the back, plus their wiring. (1) The radio mast at mastBase x -3.4, z -3.0, top at mastTop y 6.6: a square lattice tower of four metalGrey legs tapering from 0.6 base width to 0.2 at the top, horizontal rungs and diagonal braces every 0.55 m, a small concrete footing (rockLight) with a snow cap, three tiers of guy wires (thin metalDark rods) running to four ground anchors (small rock blocks with a ring) at about 2 m from the base, avoiding the cabin footprint (x -2.9..1.3, z -1.9..1.9), a signalRed and white striped section near the top, a parabolic dish (a lathe bowl in labWhite, a metalDark feed arm) pointing toward +Z-left at y 5.0, a pair of yagi antennas (a thin boom with cross rods) at y 5.7, and a glowing signalRed beacon sphere on top with a small cage. (2) The wind turbine at turbineBase x 3.0, z -3.1: a tapered 8-sided tubular tower in labWhite from base radius 0.22 to 0.1, up to y 4.9, with a rockLight footing and a small safetyOrange door-panel box at the base, a nacelle box (labWhite with a labTeal stripe) at the top, with the hub at turbineHub (z -2.75, y 5.0): a spinner nose cone (safetyOrange), and three tapered blades in labWhite (radius 1.3, flat plates in the XY plane facing +Z, spaced at 120 degrees, one pointing up and slightly angled, with safetyOrange tips). A small tail vane at the back of the nacelle. (3) Power: a small battery and solar array on the ground at x -1.4..0.4, z -3.6..-2.6, three tilted solar panels (frameDark frame, iceDeep cells with thin metalGrey grid lines, snow lightly dusting the upper edge) on metalGrey legs, and a thin black cable (frameDark) drooping from the turbine base to labBackWall as a chain of small straight segments.
parts.attaches: Mast footing sits at mastBase; turbine tower at turbineBase with its hub at turbineHub; power cable ends at labBackWall on the labModule. Everything stands on terrainTop. The turbine blades must stay at y>3.7 above the lab roof radome (top 3.6).

parts.builds: The working yard props, in two zones that must stay out of the cabin footprint (x -2.9..1.6, z -1.9..3.5), the lab footprint (x 1.3..4.1, z -1.9..1.6) and the path. Zone A, left flank, x -4.3..-3.0, z -1.0..3.2 at tankBed (-3.6, 0.35, 1.0): two horizontal cylindrical fuel tanks (8-sided, length 1.5, radius 0.38, one in safetyOrange, one in tarpOchre, with metalDark saddle cradles, cap bands, a filler hatch and a gauge dial) lying along z at x -3.7, a pipe run with a valve wheel in signalRed, a stack of five fuel drums (alternating safetyOrange, labTeal, signalRed with metalDark rim bands and cream stripes) near z 2.6, and a stack of wooden crates (wood, woodDark straps) covered by an ochre tarp with rope ties. Zone B, front right, x 1.6..4.3, z 1.7..4.2: a parked snowmobile at vehiclePark (2.8, 0.35, 2.9) facing +Z, built from a chunky cabinWall body shell and a safetyOrange cowl, a dark seat, windscreen (iceBlue), handlebars, headlight (windowGlow), two front skis (metalDark, curved up at the tips) and a rear tracked belt (a metalDark box with groove rib strips), a snow dusting on its seat. A sled at sledSpot (0.9, 0.35, 3.3) just right of the path, with two wooden runners curled up at the front, slats, a cargo load of two cream-strapped duffel boxes in labTeal and tarpOchre, a rope loop. Also a small cluster of equipment: a snow shovel stuck in a drift and a pair of skis standing against the lab's front corner at x 4.0, z 1.5, kept small, plus a signal-flag pole with a signalRed banner at x 4.0, z 3.6.
parts.attaches: All objects rest on terrainTop. Tanks at tankBed, snowmobile at vehiclePark, sled at sledSpot. It never overlaps the cabin or lab footprints or the stairFoot path.
